Source: **2026-10-31 - both strings varied MPE.als**, saved **2026-11-16T19:58:55.016813-08:00**. Open-song identity confirmed in Ableton. Notes are from this saved set; unsaved edits, audio-track pitches and MPE pitch bends are not represented. Standard six-string **E A D G B E**, no capo, assumed for these guitar reductions. All written pitch classes and slash-bass classes are retained; octave placement may differ.

The developed arrangement uses the harmonic cycle **Am9/C → Dm9 → Fmaj7 → E7/G♯**. The original muted chord-reference track starts at Fmaj7 instead (see its separate part).

## Voicing details

The low-string clips named Am9/C mostly contain **A, C, E, G** (Am7), with changing bass notes; their B ninth is not present in that layer. The clips named Dm9 mostly contain **D, F, A, C** (Dm7); E can appear in other parts. The full ninth chords above come from the explicit chord-reference MIDI. For exact low-string reductions, select **Low-string MIDI — actual voicings**.
